"""Read-only sweep for the W2-96 full probe: map reader over every README, opt-in overlap, groups per map.

Run: python3 -I sweep.py <tree>   (imports gov from <tree>/src; reads only; writes nothing)
"""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

tree = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(tree / "src"))
from gov.accept import runner  # noqa: E402

acc = tree / "tests" / "acceptance"

# --- (a) lifted / breadth overlap, by entry string and by path containment ---------------------------------------
entries = runner.optin_entries(tree / "tests")
lifted = [e for s, e in entries if s == "lifted"]
breadth = [e for s, e in entries if s == "breadth"]
print(f"entries: lifted {len(lifted)}, breadth {len(breadth)}")
bset = set(breadth)
same = sorted(set(lifted) & bset)
print(f"(a) identical entry strings in both groups: {len(same)}")
for e in same[:20]:
    print("   ", e)


def target(entry):
    path, _, part = entry.partition("::")
    return (tree / path.rstrip("/")).resolve(), part


contain = []
for le in lifted:
    lp, lpart = target(le)
    for be in breadth:
        bp, bpart = target(be)
        if le == be:
            continue
        # a breadth path entry (no part) that holds the lifted target, or a breadth node id inside a lifted path
        if not bpart and (lp == bp or bp in lp.parents):
            contain.append((le, be, "breadth path holds lifted"))
        elif not lpart and (bp == lp or lp in bp.parents):
            contain.append((le, be, "lifted path holds breadth"))
        elif lpart and bpart and lp == bp and (lpart == bpart or bpart.startswith(lpart + "[")
                                                or lpart.startswith(bpart + "[")):
            contain.append((le, be, "same node"))
print(f"(a) containment overlaps (any kind): {len(contain)}")
for row in contain[:30]:
    print("   ", row)

# --- (b) every README: the reader's result; refused cells as masked; suspicious ranges -------------------------
RANGEISH = re.compile(r"(?i)(?:success|failure|kpi|\b[sfk])[ \t-]*\d+\s*(?:\s[–—-]\s|\sthrough\s|\sthru\s|\sup to\s|…|~)\s*\d")
FILEISH = re.compile(r"[\w./-]+\.(?:json|ya?ml|txt|md|toml|cfg|ini|sh|xml|csv)\b|\bfixture\b|\bconftest\b", re.I)
refused, readable, unreadable, nomap = [], [], [], []
suspicious = []
for readme in sorted(acc.glob("*/README.md")):
    text = readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    name = readme.parent.name
    try:
        mapping = runner.parse_map(text)
    except runner.Unlisted as refusal:
        number, cell = refusal.args
        refused.append((name, number, runner._masked(cell)))
        continue
    except runner.Unreadable:
        unreadable.append(name)
        continue
    if not mapping:
        nomap.append(name)
        continue
    readable.append((name, mapping))
    for number, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        line = raw.strip()
        if line.startswith("|") and RANGEISH.search(line):
            suspicious.append((name, number, line[:160]))

print(f"(b) READMEs: readable {len(readable)}, refused (Unlisted) {len(refused)}, unreadable {len(unreadable)}, "
      f"no map {len(nomap)}")
print("(b) refused cells, as gov accept would name them (masked):")
for name, number, cell in refused:
    flag = "  <-- file/fixture-like word left" if FILEISH.search(cell) else ""
    print(f"    {name} line {number}: {cell!r}{flag}")
print(f"(b) table rows holding a spaced-dash/through/thru/up to/…/~ range after a line name: {len(suspicious)}")
for row in suspicious[:30]:
    print("   ", row)

# --- (c) groups each readable map would enable / mark report-only --------------------------------------------
print("(c) readable maps needing a group (needed -> enabled / report_only):")
for name, mapping in readable:
    folder = (acc / name).resolve()
    try:
        needed = runner.needed_optins(tree, folder, mapping)
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"    {name}: needed_optins raised {type(error).__name__}")
        continue
    if needed:
        enabled = [s for s in needed if s != runner.REPORT_ONLY]
        ro = [runner.REPORT_ONLY] if runner.REPORT_ONLY in needed else []
        print(f"    {name}: needed {needed} -> optin {enabled}, report_only {ro}")
